title.value: Impact in Software Engineering Activities After One Year of COVID-19 Restrictions for Startups and Established Companies
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned at the beginning of the document, alongside details about the publication and authors.
title.quote: Impact in Software Engineering Activities After One Year of COVID-19 Restrictions for Startups and Established Companies

extractions.description: The paper assesses the impact of COVID-19 restrictions on software engineering activities for startups and established companies. It examines different software engineering activities over a year after the pandemic's onset, highlighting differences based on company type. It utilizes a global survey across software development companies, analyzing impacts across various activities such as requirements engineering, software architecture, user experience design, and more. Overall, the study seeks to understand how prolonged remote work conditions have affected these sectors and informs potential long-term changes in work patterns.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not directly address climate change, environmental impact, or eco-responsibility in the context of software engineering activities affected by COVID-19. It focuses more on human factors, operational changes, and productivity in the software development sector.
primary_category.quote: the COVID-19 pandemic required software development teams to adapt, being forced to work remotely and adjust the software engineering activities accordingly.

secondary_categories.justification: There are no additional categories related to eco-responsibility identified within the focus of this paper. The document remains centered on software development processes and adjustments due to COVID constraints.
secondary_categories.quote: No studies have been found comparing software startups and established companies either.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's main focus is on software engineering and the impacts of COVID-19, not aligning with any predefined sub-categories related to eco-responsibility.
primary_sub_category.quote: Our approach was to design a cross-sectional survey and distribute it online among software development companies worldwide.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: No additional sub-category related to eco-responsibility is applicable based on the content and focus of the study, which is related to the changes in software development activities due to remote work.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: The survey received 170 valid answers from 29 countries, and for all the software engineering activities, we found that most respondents did not observe a significant impact.

new_primary_category.value: Impacts of Remote Work on Software Development
new_primary_category.justification: The primary focus of this paper is on the adaptation of software engineering activities and work practices due to the remote work conditions imposed by COVID-19.
new_primary_category.quote: This paper aims to investigate the impacts of COVID-19 on software development activities after one year of the pandemic restrictions, comparing the results between startups and established companies.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper specifically analyses effects on various software engineering processes under remote work conditions due to the pandemic.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: The participants were asked about their perception of COVID-19’s pandemic impact on different software engineering activities: requirements engineering, software architecture, user experience design, software implementation, and software quality assurance.
